d5414106: 1. Block the category, not the app

9cb1e6a5: 2. Set the window wider than the problem
d810b572: If you lose evenings from 9pm, start the block at 8. Relapse happens in the half-hour before the rule takes effect, when you know it is coming and get one last session in.

de606ead: This is the one that decides the outcome. A block you can lift is a block you will lift. The two setups that hold are having someone else set a passcode you never see, or using an app where another person approves each unlock remotely.
